brief: Cold outreach tech stack — lead source, enrichment, sending tool, warmup, reply detection, CRM sync.

slots.tagline: The modern prospecting engine that surfaces decision-makers ready to buy.
slots.f1Body: Target by title, industry, and company size with precision.
slots.f2Body: Track job changes and engagement to time your outreach perfectly.
slots.f3Body: Connect and message prospects without leaving the platform.

slots.tagline: An AI research layer that builds detailed dossiers on every target contact.
slots.f1Body: Query recent news, funding rounds, and tech stacks instantly.
slots.f2Body: Every insight links to a credible source for verification.
slots.f3Body: Understand pain points and priorities before writing copy.

slots.tagline: Async video messaging that humanizes cold outreach and doubles reply rates.
slots.f1Body: Capture your screen and webcam in one click from any tab.
slots.f2Body: See exactly who watched, skipped, or rewatched your pitch.
slots.f3Body: Embed calendar or form buttons directly inside the video.

slots.tagline: Open-source workflow automation that warms inboxes and sequences follow-ups.
slots.f1Body: Drag nodes to build branching outreach logic without code.
slots.f2Body: Space sends across days to mimic natural human behavior.
slots.f3Body: Launch sequences from form fills, replies, or CRM updates.

slots.tagline: A flexible database that ingests replies and scores lead temperature in real time.
slots.f1Body: Filter conversations by sentiment, stage, or last reply date.
slots.f2Body: Formula fields flag hot leads based on reply keywords.
slots.f3Body: Push qualified replies downstream to your CRM instantly.

slots.tagline: The glue between your stack and CRM that keeps deal data flowing flawlessly.
slots.f1Body: Route replies, meetings, and notes to the right CRM records.
slots.f2Body: Built-in replay ensures no lead update ever gets lost.
slots.f3Body: Connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive in minutes.

slots.ctaBody: Steal this exact cold outreach stack and start booking meetings this week.
